revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue from outlicensing intellectual properties to related parties and providing contract development and manufacturing organization services.
revenueModel.evidence: As of the date of this Report, the Company's revenue has come from outlicensing our intellectual properties and providing CDMO services.

changes.text: In 2024, the company entered into licensing agreements with ForSeeCon Eye Corporation and OncoX BioPharma, Inc. for ophthalmology and oncology products respectively.
changes.evidence: On March 25, 2024, the Company and BioFirst each entered into a twenty-year, global definitive licensing agreement (the "FEYE Licensing Agreement") with ForSeeCon Eye Corporation, a company registered in the British Virgin Islands ("FEYE") for the products in the Company and BioFirst's Ophthalmology pipeline, including Vitargus (the "Vitargus Products").
